scenicChapters.title: Norwegian Scenic Route Valdresflye
scenicChapters.narrative: The valley floor is behind you and the road starts working for its height at about 7.1%. Corners stack above one another where the ground allows nothing straighter — first and second gear more often than not. Look through each corner to the next one and let the engine do the holding.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Norwegian Scenic Route Valdresflye
scenicChapters.narrative: 1389 m come off over 32 km at around 7.6%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it. Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

norwegian-scenic-route-valdresflye.story: A one-way ride of 169 km, Heggenes to Vågåmo - roughly 2 h 17 in the saddle. On the way it passes Valdresflye and Gjende. The highest point is about 1,500 m. Valdresflye is subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
